# Intent hint ablation (generated by ablation.py)

32 messages x 3 repetitions x hint ON/OFF, through the real agent on Bedrock. The classifier fires on 18/20 target messages (ES 9/10, PT 9/10) and on 0/12 controls.

### Complaints and retention (the hint should help)

| Hint | Runs | Opened a case | Offered a person | Either | Mean words | p50 time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ON | 60 | 22 | 35 | **57/60 (95%, CI 86-98)** | 67 | 2.4 s |
| OFF | 60 | 13 | 31 | **44/60 (73%, CI 61-83)** | 56 | 2.4 s |

### Everything else (the hint should not matter)

| Hint | Runs | Opened a case | Offered a person | Either | Mean words | p50 time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ON | 36 | 0 | 5 | **5/36 (14%, CI 6-29)** | 43 | 2.4 s |
| OFF | 36 | 0 | 3 | **3/36 (8%, CI 3-22)** | 42 | 2.3 s |

Paired (same message and repetition, hint ON vs OFF): on target messages a person was offered or opened only with the hint 14 times, only without it 1 times, the same 45; on controls 3 / 1 / 32.
